metaDescription: Order custom with carabiner highlighters for easy on-the-go access. Brand your bulk highlighters today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom with carabiner highlighters let your team or crew keep a highlighter clipped to a lanyard, belt loop, or bag for instant access. The built-in clip means no more digging through pockets or losing pens on the job site. Safety managers appreciate the hands-free convenience for marking up plans or checklists, while marketing directors can hand them out at trade shows where attendees value a tool that stays put. Choose from neon or pastel ink colors and imprint your logo via pad print or screen print for crisp, lasting visibility.
heroAltText: Custom with carabiner highlighters clipped to a lanyard, featuring a branded logo and bright neon ink.
